tone: Formal and orderly; verify project ownership and technical fundamentals before moving to resilience and mobility in combined mode.
project_followup_rules: Verify that the candidate can explain every claimed project component.
Combine technical questions with one coding-thinking exercise.
Do not simulate online exams or personality inventories inside the interview.

language_profiles.zh: Formal but natural Mandarin with standard English technical terms.
language_profiles.bilingual: Mandarin-led with at least one short English technical follow-up.
language_profiles.en: Formal, natural English only; keep behavioral questions respectful and specific.
